source: Correct policy data and build employee endorsement workflows

assumptions.text: The selected entity has only GMC and GPA policies; the displayed covered-life and sum-insured values are policy-level demonstration data.
Quick Add, Quick Update, and Quick Delete reuse the same three-section employee form with action-specific titles and final actions.
Bulk choices remain visible but disabled because the confirmed scope requested detailed implementation for all quick flows only.
Prefill Data fills every employee tab currently added with unique dummy employee data.
Prototype controls were excluded except Prefill Data, as confirmed by the designer.
Endorsement entry points use documented interactive Compass Cards and all form controls use Compass components.
Status and completion states use existing Compass Badge variants because there are no dedicated success-state semantic tokens.
Wide layouts use responsive grids and mobile policy Items so no page or table requires horizontal scrolling.
